welcome.text: Another traveller at the fire. I am Edda. We keep a lantern for every soul who has not found the road home.

choices.label: Tell me about the unlit road.

return.text: Your lantern is still burning. Rest your eyes a moment; the forest asks enough of them.

choices.label: Tell me about the unlit road.

refuge.text: Ashen Refuge was a watch post before the roads fell silent. Now we shelter whoever reaches its stones. Beyond the forest lies the old graveyard, and beneath it a crypt that should have stayed quiet.

unlit-road.text: The missing followed three signs: a scorched forest cache, the waykeeper marks among the graves, and a light beneath the crypt. My task is called Embers on the Road. Read its steps in your quest journal. Come back to my lantern when the forest is safe enough to search; I will see your journey supplied. The deeper light is a beginning, not an ending.

choices.label: I will consult my quest journal.

conclusion.text: The lanterns are quiet. Sevra bound their light to names that could never leave the vault; you have opened the road for them. Tonight we burn one lamp for the living. Ashen Refuge will remember who brought the dawn back. Act 1 complete.

choices.label: Keep a light for those still travelling.
I will rest by the fire.

welcome.text: Orren Thale. I used to record the names of roads. These days I record who returns from them.

choices.label: Tell me about the unlit road.

return.text: A returning face is better than any mark in my ledger. Which road troubles you?

choices.label: Tell me about the unlit road.

roads.text: Follow the forest trail to the Forgotten Graveyard. Its broken passage leads down into the Ancient Crypt. Keep the return path in mind; a brave journey still needs a safe ending.

beacon.text: There is an old light in the far chamber. Attune it, then return through the graveyard and forest. Edda will want to see your lantern beside the fire again.

unlit-road.text: When Edda has heard your forest report, follow Names Beneath the Ash in your journal. Search the graveyard caches, quiet its guard and bring the road back to me. I can point you to the crypt beacon after that. Keep what you find; we need no token torn out of your pack. A report and a safe return will do.

choices.label: I will consult my quest journal.
